# Phase Two — Integration and File Map

The Awtsmoos lets the clean branch become a new vessel where no unfinished neighbor is mistaken for our own flame;
Awtsmoos.com receives complete files only, with origin truth and release custody written beside each name.

## Clean integration strategy

Create a new worktree from the newest fetched `origin/main`. Never merge/rebase the dirty root. Never stage the root wholesale. Transfer only the exact complete Chitas release files and proven reader dependencies. Compare each transferred file against both source-root bytes and latest-origin bytes before committing.

## Clean-tree checks before UX edits

1. Each release file hash equals dirty-root frozen source immediately after transfer.
2. Every release source/test file remains <=120 lines.
3. Every JS/MJS parses.
4. No `chabad.org`, `externalHref`, `virtualStudy` remains in production Chitas path.
5. No stale `native-chitas-001` remains in changed browser-facing Chitas owners.
6. Native range resolves exact Ikar sections against the running API.
7. Dynamic discussion endpoint returns ordinary thread envelope.
8. Dynamic route returns native reader shell.
9. Reader shell guard and Chitas-aware nav contract pass.
10. `git diff --check` clean.

## UX owner boundaries

Only improve files whose purpose is Chitas UI: `chitas-week.js`, `chitas-week.css`, `masthead.js`, `masthead.css`, and if necessary card rendering behavior gated by `raw.chitasStudy`. Avoid unrelated global style rewrites.

## Release owner boundaries

Inspect the current `bhRelease` script and docs from the clean latest-main worktree before activation. Use dry-run/preflight if available. Push only a commit whose parent is current `origin/main` or a later fetched main. Never force push.
